_comment: The 'Find your fit' quiz on New here (/new-members/ and /es/bienvenida/). Each option points to a working group by its exact name in working-groups.json (the build fails if a name doesn't match), or to null for the 'not sure yet' answer. The group's description is shown with the result.

options.en: I want to help get good people elected.
options.es: Quiero ayudar a elegir a buena gente.

options.en: Surveillance cameras in my town worry me.
options.es: Me preocupan las cámaras de vigilancia en mi pueblo.

options.en: I like reading and talking about ideas.
options.es: Me gusta leer y conversar sobre ideas.

options.en: I like meeting people and starting conversations.
options.es: Me gusta conocer gente y empezar conversaciones.

options.en: I want to help my neighbors directly.
options.es: Quiero ayudar a mis vecinos directamente.
